items.title: Ford Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Cost Pressures & EV Strategy
items.summary: Ford raises 2026 profit outlook, outlines EV and battery plans while noting cost pressures, aiming for stable 2027 profitability.
items.evidence: Ford raised its 2026 adjusted EBIT guidance to $10.5-$11 billion from $10-$11 billion.

items.title: Ford Motor Co. Earnings Call Signals Profitable Pivot
items.summary: Ford's Q3 earnings show strong profitability, cash generation, and growth in EV and auto-adjacent businesses despite modest revenue pressure.
items.evidence: Ford reported Q3 adjusted EBIT of $2.7 billion and used that momentum to lift the low end of its full-year adjusted EBIT outlook to a range of $10.5 billion to $11 billion.

items.title: Ford Issues Massive Recall For Nearly 4.4 Million Trucks
items.summary: Ford recalls over 4.3 million trucks due to software fault, incurring costs and potential brand impact despite OTA fix.
items.evidence: Ford is recalling 4,380,609 vehicles for a software issue.

items.title: Ford Energy Says Most Battery Storage Capacity Filled Through 2028
items.summary: Ford Energy secures strong demand and contracts covering 80% of 2028 capacity, boosting Ford's battery storage outlook.
items.evidence: Ford Energy just revealed that it's facing strong customer demand for its U.S.-assembled grid-scale battery storage units, and in fact, has finalized contracts and late-stage negotiations that account for over 80 percent of its capacity in 2028.

items.title: Sheffield Lake announces $250,000 Ford Motor Company donation for new community playground
items.summary: Ford donates $250,000 for a new playground in Sheffield Lake, boosting community goodwill.
items.evidence: Sheffield Lake announced Thursday that it received a $250,000 donation from Ford Motor Company that will fund a new playground at the Joyce Hanks Community Center at 4575 Lake Road.

items.title: Blue Ford Mustang GTD Suddenly Becomes a Street Monster, Albeit Only Across Imagination Land, Sadly
items.summary: Ford unveils affordable EV truck pricing, launches hypercar program, and records record-breaking Mustang GTD lap times.
items.evidence: The Blue Oval has continued its teaser campaign for the upcoming 2027 Fathom with a recent post describing the truck’s bidirectional charging function, which is coming with 10 kW of power and some caveats.

items.title: VestGen Advisors LLC Sells 651,801 Shares of Ford Motor Company $F
items.summary: Ford beats Q3 earnings and raises outlook low end, but revenue drops and analysts stay cautious, leading to modestly positive outlook.
items.evidence: Ford’s third-quarter adjusted earnings beat expectations at $0.49 per share versus $0.41 anticipated, although revenue fell 2% year over year to $49.53 billion.

items.title: Pick of the Day: 1957 Ford Fairlane 500 Sunliner Convertible
items.summary: A restored 1957 Ford Fairlane with modern upgrades is listed for $168,000, highlighting brand heritage but little impact on Ford's business.
items.evidence: The Fairlane 500 Sunliner was a huge point of pride for Ford Motor Company in 1957.

items.title: Ford CEO Jim Farley defends automaker's ties to Chinese companies
items.summary: Ford faces criticism over Chinese partnerships while defending its EV battery strategy, indicating regulatory risk but also strategic collaboration.
items.evidence: Ford’s currently partnered with CATL for its EV battery development and battery energy storage systems.

items.title: Ford Recalls F-Series Trucks for Speedometer and Tachometer Issue
items.summary: Ford recalls over 100,000 trucks for faulty analog gauges, affecting up to 10,000 units and raising cost and brand concerns.
items.evidence: Only 1 percent of the recall population is believed to actually contain the defect.

items.title: Jim Farley Reaffirms 2027 Launch for Ford’s $28K Cybertruck Rival, the Fathom EV — the Price Gap Could Buy You a Tesla Model Y
items.summary: Ford announced its low‑priced Fathom electric pickup for 2027, promising strong market appeal against Tesla.
items.evidence: Ford says the Fathom will start at $28,350 before destination and delivery charges, with the standard-range battery.

items.title: DTE brings a 100 MW Michigan solar farm online to help power Ford’s manufacturing footprint with more homegrown renewable electricity
items.summary: DTE’s 100 MW Michigan solar farm will supply Ford’s factories with renewable power, advancing its decarbonisation targets.
items.evidence: By the end of 2027, every Ford vehicle manufactured in Michigan will be assembled with the equivalent of 100% carbon-free electricity.

items.title: Ford to recall over 223K vehicles over fuel tank issue
items.summary: Ford recalls over 223,000 US F-150s due to fuel tank leak risk, offering free inspections and replacements.
items.evidence: Ford Motor Company is recalling 223,472 vehicles in the United States over an issue with the fuel tank that could result in a leak, the US National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) said on Saturday.

items.title: Ford Rolls Out 2027 Mustang Mach-E Trail Package
items.summary: Ford introduces higher‑priced 2027 Mustang Mach‑E Trail, aiming to capture cost‑sensitive buyers and boost future shipments.
items.evidence: FoMoCo expects Trail shipments to kick off in the first quarter of 2027.

items.title: Ford Motor drives another $1 billion investment into Kentucky Truck Plant
items.summary: Ford invests $1 billion in Kentucky Truck Plant, adding a new paint shop, retaining jobs and signaling confidence in U.S. manufacturing.
items.evidence: Ford Motor Company is investing $1 billion in its Kentucky Truck Plant in Louisville.

items.title: Weekly Recalls: Ford (2), Honda, Jaguar, Porsche **DO NOT DRIVE **, Ram Trucks, Subaru **DO NOT DRIVE**, Toyota **Fire Risk**, Volvo
items.summary: Ford recalls 2015 Transit Connect and 2025-27 F-150 models for camera and seat issues, offering free repairs.
items.evidence: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2015 Transit Connect vehicles that were previously remedied under NHTSA recall number 25V572.

items.title: Ford Plans to Overtake Toyota in a Critical Business. Here's Why It Matters.
items.summary: Ford's CPO sales jump 44% Q3 via Amazon partnership, boosting loyalty and positioning to outpace Toyota, improving long‑term outlook.
items.evidence: Ford's impressive 44% gain in CPO sales during Q3 comes with the industry's CPO sales declining 2.5% through August, according to Automotive News Data Center.

items.title: Ford ran a ‘soft layoff’ through rigged performance ratings, suit claims
items.summary: Lawsuit alleges Ford used forced rankings to terminate a long‑tenured employee, raising age and disability discrimination claims.
items.evidence: The filing calls this a mechanism for Ford to cut long‑tenured staff under the appearance of poor performance, alleging it has “already resulted in the termination of scores of competent salaried employees.”

items.title: Ford Scrapped Its Electric F-150, But Now The Truck's Selling Like Hot Cakes
items.summary: Ford halted Lightning production, yet used trucks sell fast at higher prices, indicating residual demand despite the model’s failure.
items.evidence: Ford eventually ended production in December 2025, just four years after its initial reveal, primarily due to low demand.

items.title: Judge OKs Class Action Lawsuit Against Ford for Faulty Fuel Pumps
items.summary: Ford faces a class‑action lawsuit over alleged diesel fuel pump defects, adding legal risk and potential costs.
items.evidence: One of its recent legal battles involves an alleged fuel pump defect in Power Stroke diesel engines, with a judge granting class-action status to the lawsuit on September 30, 2026.

items.title: Ford Motor Company Exports and Imports
items.summary: Ford's August 2026 shipments fell 22% YoY despite a 5.88% 3‑year CAGR growth.
items.evidence: In August 2026, Ford Motor Company received 812 shipments, a change of -22% from the same month of the previous year, when Ford Motor Company received 1,041 shipments.

items.title: Weekly Recalls: Audi *FIRE RISK*, Ford (2), Land Rover, Lexus, Toyota
items.summary: Ford recalls over 130,000 vehicles for instrument cluster and tailgate cable issues, posing safety concerns.
items.evidence: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2025-2026 F-250 SD, F-350 SD, F-450 SD, F-550 SD, F-600, 2026 F-150, and F-750 SD vehicles.

items.title: Ford Patents Autonomous System to Protect Parked Vehicles from Theft
items.summary: Ford patents autonomous self‑relocating security system, enhancing its autonomous and anti‑theft capabilities.
items.evidence: Ford has filed a patent for an autonomous system that allows parked vehicles to relocate themselves to avoid danger or prevent wheel theft.

items.title: Vehlo’s Total Customer Connect AI Receptionist Named a Preferred Partner by Ford Motor Company
items.summary: Ford partners with Vehlo's AI receptionist, giving dealers 24/7 service and expected gains in customer satisfaction, revenue and retention.
items.evidence: Vehlo's Total Customer Connect AI Receptionist(AIR) has been named a preferred partner by Ford Motor Company and is eligible for the Ford Dealer Advertising Co-Op Program and the Lincoln Brand Exclusive Advertising Program.

items.title: Forget Ford's Lucrative Dividend. GM Has a Different and Perhaps Better Way to Reward Investors.
items.summary: Article highlights GM’s aggressive buybacks and stock surge, implying Ford lags behind, potentially hurting Ford’s outlook.
items.evidence: It's not a coincidence that since the beginning of 2023 GM's stock price has surged almost 130%, which is even more meaningful when you compare it to rivals Ford Motor Company (NYSE: F) and Stellantis (NYSE: STLA).
